title: John Spytek: Having Kirk Cousins will help coaches sleep a little better at night

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: John Spytek: Having Kirk Cousins will help coaches sleep a little better at night
sources.description: The Raiders signed Kirk Cousins to be a veteran leader at quarterback, someone who can help establish how the team would like its offense to work under new head coach Klint Kubiak.
